headlines.title: Looking back on Dolly Parton's groundbreaking career and music legacy
headlines.description: Country music legend Dolly Parton has died at the age of 80. Her family announced the news in a video posted to social media. NBC News' Chloe Melas reports on the icon's life and legacy.

headlines.title: Dolly Parton through the years, in photos: From ‘9 to 5’ secretary to ‘Hannah Montana’ godmother
headlines.description: Until she died Tuesday at age 80, Dolly Parton was the beloved Queen of Country music.

headlines.title: Fans and fellow artists post tributes to Dolly Parton
headlines.description: NBC News' Chloe Melas and Brian Balthazar discuss the range of messages pouring in for country music legend Dolly Parton, who passed away today at 80.

headlines.title: Sen. Darline Graham thanks Trump after winning GOP Senate primary runoff in S.C.
headlines.description: Sen. Darline Graham expressed her gratitude to President Trump after her projected win over Rep. Ralph Norman in South Carolina’s Republican primary runoff. Trump recruited, endorsed, and campaigned for Graham after her brother, Sen. Lindsey Graham, passed away.

headlines.title: The second Dan Sullivan makes the general election in Alaska’s Senate race
headlines.description: NBC News projects that GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan and Republican Dan J. Sullivan will face off in the general election alongside former Rep. Mary Peltola, a Democrat.

headlines.title: Trump-backed Mike Mazzei wins the GOP nomination in the Oklahoma governor’s race
headlines.description: Former state Sen. Mike Mazzei has secured the Republican nomination for governor in Oklahoma, NBC News projects, a victory for President Donald Trump’s preferred candidate.

headlines.title: Trump-backed Mike Mazzei wins the GOP nomination in the Oklahoma governor’s race
headlines.description: Former state Sen. Mike Mazzei has secured the Republican nomination for governor in Oklahoma, NBC News projects, a victory for President Donald Trump’s preferred candidate.

headlines.title: Democratic socialists notch another win in the Oklahoma Senate primary runoff
headlines.description: Nurse N’Kiyla Jasmine Thomas has won the Democratic Senate nomination in Oklahoma, NBC News projects, defeating an older, more moderate opponent.

headlines.title: The second Dan Sullivan makes the general election in Alaska’s Senate race
headlines.description: NBC News projects that GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan and Republican Dan J. Sullivan will face off in the general election alongside former Rep. Mary Peltola, a Democrat.

headlines.title: Canada announces new tariffs on the U.S. as trade tensions rise
headlines.description: The Canadian government retaliated against President Donald Trump’s latest wave of tariffs by raising tariffs on steel products and imposing a swath of new duties on $20 billion in U.S. products exported to Canada. NBC News' Christine Romans reports on the new tariffs unveiled by Canada as the trade war with the U.S. continues.

headlines.title: Trump administration says it might demolish the Kennedy Center if court blocks renovations
headlines.description: Justice Department attorneys called the Kennedy Center “structurally unsound, fundamentally unsafe, and embarrassing to the Nation’s Capital.”

headlines.title: Immigrant dad of USS Lincoln sailor is released from ICE detention
headlines.description: Joshua Aviles posted a family statement on Facebook saying his father, Luis Manuel Aviles, “has been released back to our family.”
